items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: >> [(prose)] Right next to it was an Italian man named Tony and they had a bar and music in the back.

ctx.x: So, I began to hang out with a friend of mine who was a dancer, he was called Freddie and Freddie, he had come in from Europe, Freddie and Al Martin, we would talk And Al Monroe. They were making it. and then Billie Holiday come on the scene/ Billie Holiday began singing beautiful. So, I won't forget this. We, they were going somewhere downtown and the Woodside Hotel it was jumping, it was jumping.
Right next to it was an Italian man named Tony and they had a bar and music in the back.
Now, what street was the Woodside Hotel?
